steps.what: Clarify customer symptoms, equipment configuration and the technical support question
Find applicable technical guidance and prepare a source-linked support response

loop.purpose: Retrieve applicable passages and draft a restricted support response.
loop.input: Checked support context and accessible controlled manuals.
loop.output: Draft with passage references, equipment applicability and unresolved questions.
loop.check: Engineer checks every instruction against the exact manual revision and actual configuration, including prohibited actions and escalation conditions.
loop.stop: One retrieval and one revision; uncertain applicability or missing evidence returns to manual support.
loop.why_not_simpler: Try native manual search first; varied customer descriptions may require semantic matching.

steps.what: Check guidance, advise customers and confirm understanding or arrange specialist escalation

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} search first, then a bounded answer desk to prepare source-linked guidance for an engineer. The engineer checks applicability before speaking through {TELEPHONY}; unsupported operational advice is escalated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant technical passages are scattered across revisions and equipment variants.
tasks.enabler_now: Revision-aware retrieval can assist preparation while keeping source passages visible.
tasks.still_hard: Customer descriptions may omit conditions essential to safe advice.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognises uncertainty and adapts explanations to customer understanding.
tasks.altitude: Less manual searching; customer advice and escalation rights stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Translate support uncertainty into a concrete inspection request.

evidence.claim: Source-linked technical retrieval is model knowledge; no digest product establishes nanosystem support accuracy or savings.

assumptions: Boundary covers the engineer's support effort; customer troubleshooting and technician visits are outside the denominator and unchanged.

Engineer produces equipment model, serial/configuration revision, symptoms, operating conditions, question and uncertainty notes during s1, including record verification. Missing identifiers trigger manual clarification before retrieval; no safe-to-operate flag is assumed.
Use native search before custom retrieval. Manual release status and equipment applicability are checked by the engineer within s2 and s3.
research_questions: Can the answer desk reject guidance for a subtly different configuration?

incremental.description: Review failed retrievals and maintain applicability examples.
Document owner maintains controlled source access.

approvals.approved_version: Exact response text, source manual revisions and equipment context; changes require new checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=92.5 gross=7.5 net=3.5 after 4 upkeep. Zero when existing search already suffices; 1 when a limited repeated support question benefits.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Engineer production processes through material investigation, process development and experimental interpretation

tasks.design: Retain nanotechnology process development with the engineer and keep its rationale in {DOCS}. Existing analytical tools support the work, while material compatibility and process feasibility remain experimental questions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Process behaviour depends on material and equipment interactions that are not covered by stable rules.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records and analysis support comparison without replacing investigation.
tasks.still_hard: A laboratory process may not scale or remain stable across batches.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer selects experiments and interprets unexpected outcomes.
tasks.altitude: No assumed change in experimental effort or decision rights.

reach.learn: Connect observed defects to material and surface properties.

evidence.claim: Retaining experimental nanotechnology process development is model knowledge; no task-specific labour saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary covers process engineering; separate production execution and formal validation are not included.
Engineer investigates requirements and observations within s1; no precomputed feasibility or material suitability contract is assumed.
Consider existing native analysis first. Zero upkeep because no new workflow, model or record capture is introduced.
research_questions: Is there a recurring calculation that can be separately measured before proposing a saving?

already_counted.description: Process investigation and engineering remain fully counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. No repeated administrative component or removed experimental labour has been demonstrated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Investigate nanotechnology options and engineer energy products against performance and environmental tradeoffs

tasks.design: Keep energy-product nanotechnology investigation and design with the engineer, documenting evidence in {DOCS}. Existing modelling and experiments support decisions, while actual durability and environmental performance require engineering evaluation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tradeoffs span material performance, manufacturing and product life.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing analysis tools can inform options but do not establish application success.
tasks.still_hard: Improved laboratory efficiency can be offset by manufacturing impact or degraded service life.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer challenges apparent improvements against the full application context.
tasks.altitude: No assumed reduction in engineering investigation.

reach.learn: Align technical comparisons with consistent lifecycle boundaries.

evidence.claim: Application-specific nanotechnology research and tradeoff judgement remain human work, based on model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is product investigation and engineering; formal lifecycle assessment, manufacturing and marketing are separately scoped.
Engineer examines raw research and observations in s1; environmental benefit and durability are not assumed as free structured flags.
Consider native research and modelling tools first. Zero upkeep because no new automation is proposed.
research_questions: Which claimed performance gain survives comparable durability and lifecycle conditions?

already_counted.description: Investigation and design judgement remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. Research and engineering work are retained without assuming laboratory computation replaces labour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop nanomaterials geometry and define dimensional constraints in the CAD environment
Construct repeated geometric features and regenerate specified variants in the CAD environment
Check nanosystems geometry, dimensional meaning and manufacturability before accepting the model

tasks.design: Configure native parameter tables and feature patterns in the CAD environment {OTHER} for repeated geometry. The engineer defines the constraints and checks the generated model against material behaviour and intended fabrication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated feature construction and variant edits consumed interactive drafting time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parameterisation can regenerate explicitly specified geometric families.
tasks.still_hard: A valid solid model does not establish nanoscale behaviour or fabrication feasibility.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer understands when geometry misrepresents the intended physical structure.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated geometry construction; design decisions remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Preserve nanoscale units, tolerances and revision identity.

evidence.claim: Native CAD parameters and repeated feature generation are model knowledge; no digest result measures nanosystems CAD labour savings.

assumptions: Boundary is computational geometric design, excluding material discovery and physical fabrication.

In s1 the engineer produces template revision, feature topology, dimensions, units, tolerances, material references, permitted parameter ranges and variant IDs. Capture and applicability checks remain counted; unsupported topology is constructed manually.
OTHER is the CAD environment. Test native feature patterns before custom code; existing automatic regeneration is not counted as saved labour.
research_questions: Do generated variants preserve nanoscale units and intended topology at permitted range limits?

already_counted.description: Parameter preparation and independent model review.

incremental.description: Maintain and independently test parameterised features.

approvals.approved_version: Exact CAD revision and parameter table snapshot; any change voids acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=80 gross=20 net=13 after 7 upkeep. Zero for already parameterised designs; 3 if only repeated features in one family benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Customer preparation and repetitive geometry can shrink while nanoscale engineering judgement remains central.
reach: Coordinate physical requirements with materials engineers and fabrication representations with drafters.
role.ambitious_version: An engineer who uses repeatable preparation to leave more attention for uncertain material behaviour.
